rationale: Before mitigation, 8 of 10 voltage samples are within the normal band [0.90, 1.10] pu, below the required 95%. Samples t03 and t04 are below the normal lower limit; no samples exceed the normal upper limit or absolute limits. A +0.025 pu tap change places all 10 samples within the normal band without absolute-limit violations, while +0.05 pu would exceed the 1.10 pu upper absolute limit at t09.
